headline: Manba Finance announces revision to credit rating
hook: Credit rating outlook updated for Manba Finance
summary: Manba Finance Limited has officially notified the NSE regarding a revision to its credit rating. The company did not disclose the specific details or the direction of the rating change in the initial exchange filing. Investors should review the full rating rationale once published by the credit rating agency. This update impacts the company's cost of borrowing and overall financial risk profile.
whats_next: Publication of the detailed credit rating rationale by the agency.
why_it_matters: Rating changes directly influence the company's future borrowing costs.

headline: Manba Finance updates exchange on compliance officer and RTA
summary: Manba Finance Limited has submitted a regulatory update to the stock exchange regarding its compliance officer and Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA). The filing concerns standard administrative disclosures required under listing regulations. Such procedural filings are routine operational updates for listed companies. Retail investors generally do not need to take any action based on standard compliance updates.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your portfolio.
